role: WorkoutSessionLifecycle extension: workout start() sequence (idle guard, HR-source resolution, provenance, Polar streaming, per-workout resets, phase flip, deferred GPS/pedometer/sensor/Zwift/geocoding/persistence/tail tasks), interval-plan voice wiring, and pause/resume; plus file-scope geocoding reset and foot-pod management helpers.
types: WorkoutSessionLifecycle.HRSource: enum — strap / watch / none heart-rate source
WorkoutSessionLifecycle.StartStamps: struct — per-block timing marks for the start() breakdown log
toplevel: HRSource enum (28-32); file-scope private @MainActor helpers deferGeocodingReset, manageFootPod, footPodManagerServes.

flags.text: footPodManagerServes re-declares the same five-sport set as pedometerSports in a different order; the two lists must be kept in sync by hand.

units.does: Public workout start: records latency entry, opens a log-correlation scope (closed by defer unless start completes), guards idle and applies thresholds/route, resolves the effective HR source (may throw strapBusy or downgrade), builds provenance and the starting session, starts Polar streaming for strap, brings recording up, logs the sync breakdown, records start-returned.

branches.effect: defer: endWorkoutCorrelation closes the scope; true: scope stays open until stop()

flags.text: applyStartParametersAndGuardIdle writes userThresholds/plannedRoute before resolveEffectiveSource or startStreaming can throw, so a failed start (strapBusy, Polar throw) leaves the idle recorder holding the new thresholds and route.

units.does: Appends (name, now) to the marks list.
Formats 'name=<ms>ms …' spans between consecutive marks from t0, plus TOTAL from t0 to the last mark.
Milliseconds between two dates as Int.
Builds a new .workout HRVSession dated now with the given provenance and WorkoutMetadata(sport:).

After Polar: resets per-workout state, installs AI providers, flips phase to .recording, wires HR observation, queues the start announcement, defers Zwift/geocoding, launches deferred start work; marks each block.
Launches baseline precompute, deferred GPS start, motion-permission probe, deferred pedometer, secondary-sensor reconnect, off-main persisted-state save, and the tail task.
Throws alreadyRecording unless phase is .idle; otherwise stores thresholds, clears breach seconds, sets planned route and resets route auto-detect flags.

branches.effect: false: warning log and throws WorkoutRecorderError.alreadyRecording; true: applies parameters

flags.text: The guard admits only .idle, but phase stays .finished after stop until acknowledgeFinished. The Watch start path explicitly lets .finished through (AppLaunchTasks.swift:52) and expects the start to proceed, and the doc on stopStaleStreamIfIdle (Start:224-226) names the Watch Start as the case it handles. In practice a Watch Start while the iPhone summary is up throws alreadyRecording ('A workout is already in progress.'), which is only logged on the phone. The Watch had already been told the start succeeded (EmuquApp.swift:773-782).

units.does: For non-strap requests returns the request; for strap stops a stale Polar stream, asks WorkoutHRSourceResolver (logs it) and acts: strapBusy → throws; reconnectThenUseStrap → connectToLastDevice and returns .strap; use(x) → returns x (strap/watch/none downgrade).

branches.effect: false: returns watch/none unchanged; true: resolves
triggers connectToLastDevice, returns .strap without waiting for the link
returns resolved (strap if connected, watch if paired, else none)

units.does: Reads live Polar recording-on-device, connected, known-devices and Watch-paired state and returns WorkoutHRSourceResolver.resolve(...).
If the Polar manager is still streaming while idle, logs and stops the stream (discarding returned points).

flags.text: The function assumes any live Polar stream is a lingering post-workout stream, but RRCollector's overnight and quick streaming use the same polarManager.startStreaming. The strap-busy check (resolver and Watch refusal) only tests isRecordingOnDevice, which is false for Verity Sense overnights, overnights with useDeviceInternalBackup=false, and quick streaming sessions. In those cases a strap workout start stops the running RRCollector stream and discards the buffered RR points (`_ =`). startStreaming then resets the buffer for the workout.

units.does: Builds DeviceProvenance for the effective source: strap uses connected device id/type (fallback 'unknown'/'Polar device'), watch 'apple-watch'/'Apple Watch', none 'none'/'No HR Source'; recordingMode .streaming.
Clears strapNotice; for strap source starts Polar streaming (may throw) and arms the device-internal backup for this workout id.

branches.effect: false: return; true: startStreaming (throw propagates out of start())

units.does: Resets all per-workout recorder state: active HR source, current session, start date, collected points, clock/pause, HR metrics, ingest cursor, samples, live pace, foot-pod baseline, power sums, motion power/foot-pod flags, last strap HR time, DFA analyzer, voice coach.
Resets elapsed seconds, pause flags, paused-motion ledger, pause timeline, device-backup arm time, stop snapshot, and the auto-pause detector.
Installs the conversation context providers and the live-workout samples provider.

Sets two closures on the VoiceConversationController: contextSnapshotProvider (fact-sheet string) and liveWorkoutSnapshotProvider (WorkoutAIContext), each built from recorder.buildContext for the current sport; nil when recorder is gone or session has no sport.

branches.cond: recorder alive and currentSession.sport non-nil (fact sheet closure)

units.does: Registers a samples provider on LiveWorkoutBroker returning recorder.samplesView via MainActor.assumeIsolated ([] once recorder is gone).

flags.text: MainActor.assumeIsolated traps if the broker ever invokes the provider off the main actor; safety rests on the comment's claim that the fact resolver runs on main.

units.does: Schedules a pre-flip main-actor latency probe, sets lifecycle.phase = .recording, logs, records phase-flip latency, schedules a post-flip probe.
Stamps now and queues a main-actor Task that logs how many ms later it ran.
For strap source subscribes to Polar HR via observeHeartRate; always records the announce-fire latency stamp.

branches.effect: true: observeHeartRate(); false: no Polar subscription (Watch/none HR come via tick loop)

units.does: Queues a main-actor Task that logs a warning if it ran >250 ms after scheduling, then calls WorkoutStartCue.announceStart(sport:).

branches.effect: true: warning log about MainActor contention; always announces

units.does: Runs the deferred Zwift broadcast start and the deferred geocoding reset.
If Zwift broadcast is enabled, queues a main-actor Task that, only while the workout is still recording, starts the BLE peripheral HR/power broadcaster and logs its duration.

branches.cond: recorder alive and phase == .recording when Task runs
branches.effect: false: return (workout stopped before task); true: startBroadcasting

units.does: For GPS sports queues a main-actor Task that calls recorder.location.startTracking() and logs its duration.

flags.text: Unlike deferZwiftBroadcast (which re-checks phase == .recording, Start.swift:463), the deferred task starts GPS without checking the workout is still recording; a stop processed before the hop leaves location tracking running after stopTracking (WorkoutRecorder+Stop.swift:129). Same pattern in deferPedometerStart.

units.does: For pedometer or GPS sports, when CoreMotion authorization is notDetermined and step counting is available, queues a main-actor empty pedometer query to raise the Motion & Fitness prompt.

branches.cond: motion sport AND authorization notDetermined AND step counting available
branches.effect: false: return; true: issues empty query on the static probe

units.does: For pedometer sports queues a main-actor Task that starts the pedometer, logs duration, and warns if >100 ms.
Applies foot-pod policy for the sport, holds the Concept2 link only for rowing, and for rowing with a known PM5 that is disconnected queues a main-actor reconnect.
Builds PersistedRecordingState (session id, start, .workout, phase 'workout:<sport>') and saves it to UserDefaults on a detached utility task; logs if save took >50 ms.

flags.text: The save runs on an unawaited detached task, while a successful archive calls PersistedRecordingState.clear() on main (Metrics:187). If the detached save lands after the clear (very short workout, contended cfprefsd, which the comment says can stall for seconds), a stale record for an already-archived workout survives and the next launch offers to recover it. The write also overwrites any RRCollector recording's state under the same key.

units.does: Queues a main-actor tail Task that (if recorder alive and still recording) starts diagnostics sampling, starts the Watch HKWorkoutSession unless watch display-only mode, loads the interval plan, starts the 1 Hz ticker, and logs timings.

branches.effect: false: return (stopped before tail ran: no ticker, no Watch session)

units.does: With no plan clears the interval controller; with a plan installs onStepChange (announce step) and onFinish (announce block complete) callbacks capturing recorder weakly, then loads the plan at startDate.
Builds the scripted interval cue line and announces it (AI-worded prompt with the line as fallback).

If InterjectionGate allows the active AI provider (Flo enabled, disclaimer accepted, consent), asks the conversation to speak an AI response to the prompt; otherwise speaks the scripted fallback via handleTrigger.

branches.effect: false: handleTrigger(fallback) and return; true: speakAIResponse(prompt)

units.does: Soft pause: only while recording and not paused; sets isPaused/autoPaused, snapshots pedometer/foot-pod distance into the paused ledger, opens a pause in the timeline, pauses location accumulation, resets auto-pause detector.
writes: mem:WorkoutRecorder.footPodOdometer (footPodDistanceMeters records the pod reading, WorkoutRecorder.swift:317-320)

units.does: Resume: only while recording and paused; clears pause flags, closes the paused-motion ledger and timeline pause, unpauses location, resets auto-pause detector.
writes: mem:WorkoutRecorder.footPodOdometer (footPodDistanceMeters records the pod reading, WorkoutRecorder.swift:317-320)

units.does: File-scope: queues a main-actor Task resetting RoadGeocodingService state; warns if it took >50 ms.

File-scope: decides if the foot-pod manager serves this sport, holds/releases its link accordingly; if served and a known device is disconnected, defers reconnectLast; if not served and connected, defers disconnect.

branches.effect: true: reconnect path; false: disconnect path

units.does: File-scope: true for run/trailRun/walk/hike/treadmill; for bike/indoorBike true only when the first known device supports power; false otherwise.

branches.effect: false: return false; true: first known device supportsPower

flags.text: Only knownDevices.first is checked for power support; with several remembered devices a power trainer that is not first is ignored and gets disconnected for a bike workout.
